SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, mini standalone build (Apache-2.0).

Downloaded unmodified from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.mini.min.js
License: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE
